Name: pdbid_ligid
Description: PDB ID and ligand HET code reported in a BindingDB cross-reference

Name: pdb_id
Description: PDB ID reported in a BindingDB ligand-target-complex cross-reference

Name: ligand_het_id
Description: Ligand HET code reported by BindingDB

Name: reactant_set_id
Description: BindingDB source reactant-set identifier, when provided

Name: monomer_id
Description: BindingDB source monomer identifier, when provided

Name: article_doi
Description: DOI of the source publication, when provided by BindingDB

Name: bindingdb_entry_doi
Description: BindingDB DOI for the source entry, when provided

Name: source_row
Description: Zero-based row number in the source BindingDB TSV

Name: target_sequences
Description: All target-chain sequences reported for this measurement

Name: target_sequence
Description: Target-chain sequence when exactly one was reported; otherwise missing

Name: endpoint
Description: Measured affinity endpoint: Ki or Kd

Name: raw_value
Description: BindingDB affinity value in nM, including any inequality sign

Name: relation
Description: Equality or inequality for the pKi/pKd value; reversed from the nM inequality because the logarithmic scale is inverse

Name: value_nm
Description: Numeric affinity value in nM without its inequality sign

Name: pchembl
Description: pKi or pKd (9 - log10 of nM value), before censoring checks
